title: Editorial act-crossfade (Springs)
engine: One pinned scroll drives N acts that crossfade 4 layers at once (full-bleed image push-zoom + split-word centre-word swap + topline swap + body crossfade). Pure set(p) across the acts.
differs: CORRECTED (S19g vs D_SPRINGS_video): springs mobile is a PINNED-SCROLL, not auto. BOTH platforms scroll-pin drive the same set(p) crossfade; the difference is LAYOUT + pin-length (desktop wide 2-col; mobile full-bleed single-col sticky, copy crossfades over frozen media per scroll-progress = T-PIN-RUNSCENE). NOT scroll-vs-time.

desktop.driver: scrollActs — set(p) = scroll progress across the pin span.

mobile.driver: autoActs — set(p) steps through acts: hold(holdMs)+ease(moveMs), loops.

engine_patch: forceMotion + manualDrive (expose set() without engine pin/ScrollTrigger; guard registerPlugin/ticker/lenis). Additive & opt-in.
entry: EditorialActCrossfadeDual.init(target, opts). Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .eac-stage > .eac-images(.eac-img[data-act]) + .eac-toplines + .eac-headline(.eac-centre>.eac-word[data-act]) + .eac-bodies(.eac-body[data-act]). Desktop wraps in .pin-wrap.
law: set(p) PURE; transform (image push-zoom) + opacity (crossfades) only; GPU; NO mix-blend/backdrop over scrubbed images; NO WebGL. reduced-motion -> first act shown.
